children: New Delhi, Oct. 20 -- Schaeffler India CEO and Managing Director Harsha Gopal Kadam was taken into custody on October 19 in connection with an investigation into a factory accident in June that killed two workers, the automotive and industrial parts maker said in an exchange filing on Tuesday.

Kadam was taken into custody late Monday by the Talegaon MIDC Police Station for investigation into the incident at the company's factory premises in Talegaon, Pune, on June 9, 2026, the company said.
